summary.en: Heavier riffs, bigger stages, tighter rhythm sections.
summary.zh: 更重的 Riff、更大的舞台、更紧的节奏组。

body.en: Hard Rock amplifies a Blues skeleton with distortion and drum impact—the arena rock of the seventies. It is Heavy Metal's direct ancestor; Grunge later rejects its guitar-hero stage persona.
body.zh: Hard Rock 用失真与鼓点冲击放大 Blues 骨架——即 70 年代体育馆摇滚。它是 Heavy Metal 的直系祖先；日后 Grunge 拒绝其吉他英雄式舞台人设。
